offering_description.value: Grows, processes and sells cannabis products through its own retail dispensaries to medical patients and adult-use consumers in several US states, with much of its product made in its own facilities.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vapes; edibles; concentrates; pre-rolls

customer_segment.value: B2C: medical cannabis patients and adult-use consumers buying at its dispensaries

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold to patients and consumers at its dispensaries

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cultivates and processes cannabis into finished products from its own grow and processing sites; brand owner: sells its own branded cannabis products through its own stores; retailer: sells finished cannabis products to individual consumers at its dispensaries

geography_served.value: US national: Operates in multiple US states, mainly Florida, with other states such as Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois and Maryland

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line of cannabis products across flower, vapes, edibles and concentrates

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail dispensaries; online: online ordering and delivery where state law allows

regulatory_exposure.value: high: needs state cannabis cultivation, processing and retail licenses from state cannabis regulators in each market

notes: State footprint and product lines may have changed; verify current operating states and products.
